payment_attempts_settled_has_txn.name: payment_attempts_settled_has_txn
payment_attempts_settled_has_txn.value: "payment_attempts"."status" not in ('approved', 'duplicate') or ("payment_attempts"."provider_txn_id" is not null and "payment_attempts"."verified_at" is not null)

products_sku_format.name: products_sku_format
products_sku_format.value: "products"."sku" ~ '^PW-[TWA][1-9][0-9]{5}$' and substr("products"."sku", 4, 1) = case "products"."category" when 'tires' then 'T' when 'wheels' then 'W' else 'A' end

products_brand_length.name: products_brand_length
products_brand_length.value: "products"."brand" is null or char_length(btrim("products"."brand")) between 1 and 80

tire_specs_flotation_has_dimensions.name: tire_specs_flotation_has_dimensions
tire_specs_flotation_has_dimensions.value: "tire_specs"."size_format" <> 'flotation' or ("tire_specs"."overall_diameter" is not null and "tire_specs"."section_width" is not null)

tire_specs_dimensions_positive.name: tire_specs_dimensions_positive
tire_specs_dimensions_positive.value:
"tire_specs"."rim_diameter" > 0
        and ("tire_specs"."width" is null or "tire_specs"."width" > 0)
        and ("tire_specs"."aspect_ratio" is null or "tire_specs"."aspect_ratio" > 0)
        and ("tire_specs"."overall_diameter" is null or "tire_specs"."overall_diameter" > 0)
        and ("tire_specs"."section_width" is null or "tire_specs"."section_width" > 0)

wheel_specs_dimensions_positive.name: wheel_specs_dimensions_positive
wheel_specs_dimensions_positive.value:
"wheel_specs"."diameter" > 0 and "wheel_specs"."width" > 0
        and ("wheel_specs"."center_bore_mm" is null or "wheel_specs"."center_bore_mm" > 0)
        and ("wheel_specs"."load_rating_lbs" is null or "wheel_specs"."load_rating_lbs" > 0)
        and ("wheel_specs"."lug_count" is null or "wheel_specs"."lug_count" between 3 and 12)
